Anmoldeep Singh

Bank of New York
  Chennai

No

let me try again... found anmoldeep singh, software engineer at general motors. still not you? 

can't find you with bank of new york. drop your linkedin url or send me your resume - need something to work with here

iit guwahati to bny chennai... that's a solid trajectory. building enterprise file-transfer systems that handle 20k+ files daily, implementing rag models on internal platforms. you're doing the real infrastructure work that keeps global finance running.

what made you pick bny over the usual startup route most iit folks take?

I chose BNY because I wanted to build a strong foundation in systems engineering by working on large-scale, business-critical platforms early in my career. The kind of distributed systems, networking, security workflows, and compliance-driven architectures at BNY aren’t something you typically get exposure to in most early-stage startups. For me, this experience was more valuable in the long run.

smart move. most people chase the shiny startup titles without understanding that distributed systems at scale is where you actually learn to build things that don't break. compliance-driven architecture, cross-network messaging, enterprise security... that's the stuff that separates engineers who can handle real load from those who panic when their app gets 100 users.

how long you been working total?
1 year 7 months

1.6 years... you're still in that sweet spot where you've got enough experience to be useful but not enough baggage to be picky. 

what kind of role you looking for next?
Looking for a role of Software Engineer with a fast paced developmental track

software engineer with fast-paced developmental track... makes sense. you've got the enterprise foundation, now you want to move fast and see real impact. 

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore and open to remote and other cities as well
1.6 years + software engineer + bangalore/remote/open... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yooooo anmoldeep you're IN! 🎯

iit guwahati to bny to whatever's next... that's a trajectory i can work with. you chose the enterprise route for the right reasons - now let's find you something that moves at startup speed with that same technical depth.

roles are gonna start flowing your way. the kind that'll make you forget why you ever worried about "fast-paced developmental track" - these companies live and breathe it.

welcome to the tal network, legend ⚡
Is there any update?
nothing matching right now, i'll ping when my team sends something good
